topic: Returning a Rental Car Early and Asking for a Refund

script.title: EARLY KEYS BACK
script.scene_zh: 租車櫃檯 · 還車退費
script.story_hook: Two days early, one flight, and a rental counter.
script.intro_zh: 提早兩天、一班飛機，還有租車還車櫃檯。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's scene is the rental return desk. Listen for refund and fuel talk.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景是租車還車櫃檯。留意退費與油量的對話。
script.outro: Early keys, honest math, safe flight. Listen once more and repeat aloud.
script.outro_zh: 早歸的鑰匙、算得清楚的退費、平安的航班。再聽一遍，大聲跟著唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a lean guy in his early twenties with shaggy dark brown hair under a red baseball cap, an oversized football jersey, khaki cargo shorts, a backpack on one shoulder, and muddy trail runners
script.char_b_description: a plump woman in her fifties with a chin-length bob dyed wine red, cat-eye glasses, a lavender blouse with a rental-company name tag, a dark pencil skirt, and low heel shoes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, returning the compact early, if that's okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ rɪˈtɝnɪŋ ðə kəmˈpækt ˈɜɹli ɪf ðæts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想提早歸還這台小車，不知道可不可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early is welcome, when did you get it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜɹli ɪz ˈwɛlkəm wɛn dɪd ju ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 提早歸還我們很歡迎，你是什麼時候取的車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, so that's four days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ soʊ ðæts fɔɹ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 星期六早上，所以今天是第四天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And today you're handing it back, just like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd təˈdeɪ jʊɹ ˈhændɪŋ ɪt bæk dʒʌst laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你今天說還就還，就這樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, yes? The plan was six days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm jɛs ðə plæn wəz sɪks deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 呃，對呀？原計畫是租六天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six, seven, we're not picky here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈsɛvən wɪɹ nɑt ˈpɪki hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 六天、七天，我們這邊不講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, my cousin texted me a better offer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈtɛkstɪd mi ə ˈbɛɾɚ ˈɑfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我表哥傳了個更好的提議給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cousin with the RV up in Seattle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌzən wɪð ði ɑɹˈviː ʌp ɪn siˈæɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 那個在西雅圖開房車的表哥？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one, now he's offering the ride home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn naʊ hiz ˈɑfɚɪŋ ðə ɹaɪd hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 就是他，現在他讓我搭他的車一起回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you're leaving two days early.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ jʊɹ ˈlivɪŋ tu deɪz ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 所以你要早兩天離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight's flight, um, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tənaɪts flaɪt ʌm ɪz ðæts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚的班機，呃，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flights are always okay here.
dialogue.phonetic: /flaɪts ɑɹ ˈɔlweɪz oʊˈkeɪ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，班機永遠沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the spirit, I'll take that energy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈspɪɹɪt aɪl teɪk ðæt ˈɛnɚdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我要的態度，這幹勁我收下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We see last-minute plans often, no shame.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi si læstˈmɪnɪt plænz ˈɔfən noʊ ʃeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我們常看到最後關頭的計畫，這不丟人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my wallet see the same mercy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ ˈwɑlət si ðə seɪm ˈmɝsi/
dialogue.zh: 那我的錢包還會有溫柔的待遇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the refund is the answer to that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ɹiˈfʌnd ɪz ði ˈænsɚ tə ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你問退費，答案就有啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refund? I thought it was all gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹiˈfʌnd aɪ θɔt ɪt wəz ɔl ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 退費？我以為錢全部押下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days come back to you, ninety-four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz kʌm bæk tə ju ˈnɪnti fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 兩天的錢會退回給你，九十四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety-four, I'm listening closer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪnti fɔɹ aɪm ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈkloʊzɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 九十四塊，我現在聽得認真多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The math is public, ask me anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæθ ɪz ˈpʌblɪk æsk mi ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 算法都公開，隨便問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the daily versus the weekly thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðə ˈdeɪli ˈvɜːzəs ðə ˈwikli θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，日租跟週租是怎麼換算的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The weekly rate divided by seven days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwikli reɪt dɪˈvaɪdəd baɪ ˈsɛvən deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 把週租的價錢除以七天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I paid six, and get two back?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ peɪd sɪks ænd ɡɛt tu bæk/
dialogue.zh: 所以我付了六天，退兩天回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's how it looks from this side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts haʊ ɪt lʊks fɹəm ðɪs saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 從我這邊看就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, wait, where's the catch hiding?
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ weɪt wɛɹz ðə kætʃ haɪdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，等等，陷阱藏在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The catch is fuel, how's the tank?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kætʃ ɪz ˈfjuəəl haʊz ðə tæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 陷阱就是油量，油箱現在怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tank? Um, halfway to a miracle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tæŋk ʌm ˈhæfˌweɪ tə ə ˈmɪɾəkəl/
dialogue.zh: 油箱？呃，距離奇蹟還有一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway means you'll buy the other half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ minz jul baɪ ði ˈʌðɚ hæf/
dialogue.zh: 一半的意思，就是你要買另一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the magic fuel here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈmædʒɪk ˈfjuəəl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡的「奇蹟油」多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-two for a full tank from us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹɾi tu fɔɹ ə fʊl tæŋk fɹəm ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 在我們這裡加滿，三十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gas station across the street charges less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡæs ˈsteɪʃən əˈkɹɑs ðə stiɹt ˈtʃɑɹdʒɪz lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 對面那家加油站好像便宜一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, but your flight is at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz bət jɔɹ flaɪt ɪz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 是便宜，但你的飛機九點起飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, fill it here, run the meter.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn fɪl ɪt hɪɹ ɹʌn ðə ˈmitɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，就在這裡加滿，計費吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, we'll top it off while you wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt wil tɑp ɪt ˈɔf waɪl ju weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，我們幫你加滿，你旁邊稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, anything hiding in the fine print?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə faɪn prɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 好，小字裡面還藏了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The toll transponder, did it come with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə toʊl ˈtɹɑnsˌpɑndɚ dɪd ɪt kʌm wɪθ ju/
dialogue.zh: 過路費感應器，有沒有跟著你回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The toll thing? Um, it's in the cup holder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə toʊl θɪŋ ʌm ɪts ɪn ðə kʌp ˈhoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那個過路費的小東西？呃，它在杯架裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, hand it over and paperwork is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd hænd ɪt ˈoʊvɚ ænd ˈpeɪpɚˌwɜːk ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 很好，交給我們，手續就結清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It beeped at me constantly, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bipɪd æt mi ˈkɑnstəntli ɪz ðæts ˈnɔɹməl/
dialogue.zh: 它一路都在嗶我，這正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud means working, quiet means trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd minz ˈwɜːkɪŋ ˈkwaɪət minz ˈtɹʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗶聲大代表運作正常，安靜才是麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it was very hardworking this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt wəz ˈvɛɹi hɑɹdˈwɜːkɪŋ ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 那這一週它工作得非常賣力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the tolls go through, or just beeps?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə toʊlz ɡoʊ θɹu ɔɹ dʒʌst bips/
dialogue.zh: 過路費有扣款成功，還是只有嗶聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bills arrived already, two of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪlz əˈɹaɪvd ɔlˈrɛdi tu əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 帳單都寄到了，一共兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Attach the receipt, they mail you the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈtætʃ ðə ɹɪˈsit ðeɪ meɪl ju ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 把收據附在單據上，他們會補發其餘的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will tonight, I promise on this pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl təˈnaɪt aɪ ˈpɹɑməs ɑn ðɪs pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就補上，用這支筆跟你保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We believe you, no notarizing needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bɪˈliv ju noʊ ˈnɑɹəˌtaɪzɪŋ ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 我們相信你，不用特別公證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, so the refund goes back to the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ soʊ ðə ɹiˈfʌnd ɡoʊz bæk tə ðə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，所以退款會回到原本那張卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same card, three to five business days.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm kɑɹd θɹi tə faɪv ˈbɪznəs deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 同一張卡，三到五個工作天入帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I email my dad the total for proof?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ ˈimeɪl maɪ dæd ðə ˈtoʊɾəl fɔɹ pruf/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把總金額寄給老爸當證據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll print it, then ask me about the tire.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil prɪnt ɪt ðɛn æsk ˈɑfɚ ðə ˈtaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我們先印收據，然後問問我輪胎的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tire got a small bubble, is that mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪɚ ɡɑt ə smɔːl ˈbʊbəl ɪz ðæt maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 輪胎鼓了一小塊，那個算我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was there Saturday, I checked twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wəz ðɛɹ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ aɪ tʃɛkt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 星期六取車時就在了，我檢查過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You checked? Nobody ever checks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tʃɛkt ˈnoʊbəˌdɪ ˈɛvɚ tʃɛks/
dialogue.zh: 你有檢查？沒人會檢查的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check, it protects everyone here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃɛk ɪt pɹəˈtɛkts ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我們會，這樣保護在場的每一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any damage I should confess before I fly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈdæmɪdʒ aɪ ʃʊd kənˈfɛs bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ flaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 搭飛機前，有什麼損壞要我主動承認的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one coffee stain on the back seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn ˈkɔfi steɪn ɑn ðə bæk sit/
dialogue.zh: 只剩後座上的一塊咖啡漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee is my cousin's crime, not mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ɪz maɪ ˈkʌzənz kraɪm nɑt maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡是我表哥的罪行，不是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll blame the stain together, quiet agreement.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil bleɪm ðə steɪn təˈɡɛðɚ ˈkwaɪət əˈɡɹimənt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就一起把帳算給咖啡漬，心照不宣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best rental return of my short life.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈɹɛntəl ɹɪˈtɝn əv maɪ ʃɔɹt laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 這是我短暫人生中最棒的一次還車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fly safe, and text the cousin our thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /flaɪ seɪf ænd tɛkst ðə ˈkʌzən aʊɹ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 一路平安，替我們向表哥說聲謝謝。

script.youtube_title_en: "Halfway to a Miracle" — Returning a Rental Car Early
script.youtube_description:
「油箱？呃，距離奇蹟還有一半」——班機臨時提早，租來的車能不能早兩天還、把錢拿回來？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在機場邊的租車還車櫃檯。

你會聽到：日租與週租的換算邏輯、退費金額怎麼報；油量不足時的加錢選擇、過路費感應器的歸還與帳單流程；輪胎舊傷誰負責、咖啡漬怎麼心照不宣的細節問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人真實的口語節奏：um、well、so、ha、whoa。聽完你就會用：Is that okay?、Where's the catch hiding?、Run the meter、Fly safe。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The tank? Um, halfway to a miracle" — your flight leaves early, and the rental car needs to go back two days sooner. This 60-line immersive English listening practice takes place right at the rental return counter.

You will hear: how the weekly rate turns into a refund, the fuel catch when the tank runs low, returning the toll transponder and handling its bills, and the small-print questions about old tire bubbles and coffee stains.

Everything stays at A2 level with real American texture: um, well, so, ha, whoa. By the end you'll own lines like Is that okay?, Where's the catch hiding?, Run the meter, and Fly safe.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak every refund out loud.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧租車還車英文｜退費算式・油量陷阱・過路費感應器｜提早兩天的班機｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
去程的計畫變了，班機提前了兩天，租的車可以早點還嗎？付過的錢還會退一部分嗎？油量差一半，來得及去加油嗎？

這一集帶大家站在機場旁的租車還車櫃檯，從報取車日期、算退費金額、處理油量與過路費感應器，一路聽到印收據與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💰 退費句：Two days come back to you, ninety-four.
⛽ 問油量：The tank? Um, halfway to a miracle.
🛣️ 感應器：The toll thing? Um, it's in the cup holder.
🧾 要收據：We'll print it, then ask me about the tire.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟臨時改期的歸途走一回，下次你的班機再早，車也能還得從容。

祝你每一次還車，都像這集一樣順利。
